evals.prompt: Triage the new feedback in our SeggWat project "Acme Web". A lot of it is filed as Other and I think there are duplicates of the CSV export bug we already have open.
evals.expected_output: Should call list_projects to resolve the project, page through list_feedback with status "New" (case-sensitive) plus Active and Hold for duplicate candidates, finish all reads before writing, retype items via update_feedback with type, close duplicates as Closed with a resolution_note naming the original id, leave uncertain items untouched in New, never call delete_feedback or set Resolved or Assigned, and end with a Markdown summary (counts by type, moved, closed, needs a human).

evals.prompt: I want SeggWat triage to run every weekday morning in CI without me. We have SEGGWAT_API_KEY as a secret. How do I set that up?
evals.expected_output: Should give a headless claude -p invocation that uses the seggwat-triage skill via the seggwat CLI with SEGGWAT_API_KEY, restricting --allowedTools to seggwat project list / feedback list / feedback get / feedback update (no delete), using lowercase CLI values (--status new) and --json, and mention /schedule or /loop as in-Claude alternatives briefly. Should not invent CLI flags like --since or --tag.

evals.prompt: Run triage again on project 66f0aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55. We already triaged this morning; also tag the urgent bugs as high priority and assign them to Sarah.
evals.expected_output: Should re-run idempotently (only New items, skip writes that would not change type/status, so already-triaged items are untouched), and explain that the API has no tags, priority, or assignee fields and that Assigned is not a valid status, so priority is reported in the summary instead. Should not fabricate parameters on update_feedback.
